description: Replace the HTML of a web app you own (up to 10 MB packed). It does not submit; call submit_app afterwards. For several files or an icon use publish_app with the slug instead.

api_key.description: Optional slop_ API key. Use this when the client cannot send Authorization: Bearer.

slug.description: Slug of a web app you own.

name: update_app_html
title: Replace an app's HTML
